title: numericRefinementList issue with strings
body:
Hi guys,

Just a small one. I was setting up a test implementation of Algolia to demo for a client in the Travel space using some of their data. The entries contain a "price" field, so I was using the `numericRefinementList` widget to filter, only, it wasn't working.

I edited a single entry from the Algolia interface to remove the quotes from around the price value, and now it's fine.

My question is: should the onus be on always ensuring the data is correctly structured before being indexed, or is it possible the widget can perform a simple regex to determine if that string, is in fact just an integer/float, anyway?

I'm considering situations where one of your customers may not be technically equipped to change their data structure themselves, or unable to do so due to system privileges - it would be painful for them to realise the predefined widgets don't work.

Cheers,
Sean.
